families.name: Core Intelligence
families.summary: Bring everyday questions, writing and learning into focus.
families.audience: People working through an idea, a decision or a new subject.
families.outcome: A clear explanation, a first draft or a learning plan you can review.
families.motif: Connections that bring a question into focus

families.name: Creative Studio
families.summary: Shape a story, visual concept or media brief around your audience.
families.audience: Creators and teams developing a story, visual concept or media brief.
families.outcome: A creative brief and visual direction ready for your judgment and refinement.
families.motif: Layers of craft around a human-directed idea

families.name: Specialist Intelligence
families.summary: Explore complex subjects with evidence and qualified human oversight.
families.audience: Researchers and specialists comparing questions across disciplines.
families.outcome: A research brief that keeps sources, uncertainty and review needs visible.
families.motif: Evidence connected to an accountable review

families.name: Business & Commerce
families.summary: Turn business questions into clear options and practical next steps.
families.audience: Teams planning customer work, operations and commercial decisions.
families.outcome: A comparison, communication draft or handoff for your team to review.
families.motif: A question becoming an actionable handoff

families.name: Developer Platform
families.summary: Map models, tools and applications to an integration you can test.
families.audience: Developers evaluating integration and application architecture.
families.outcome: An integration plan with defined interfaces, limits and verification needs.

families.name: Autonomous Workflows
families.summary: Define repeatable workflows with clear owners and human approvals.

families.motif: An ordered path with deliberate checkpoints
